messages:
leila_cs: Heads-up — Pinegrove Retail usage down ~68% week-over-week, embeddings + rerank traffic hit hardest. Dashboard shows Marketing seats inactive.
marco_ae: ugh. Did they say why? any procurement movement or PO delays? :eyes:
leila_cs: On last call they mentioned a new procurement lead joined (Jordan Lee). Also a short competitive trial with VeloxAI started yesterday. Not sure of duration.
jordan_csm: I was on the intro call — Jordan Lee asked for a cost & latency comparison vs Velox. They’re testing a few inference configs. Mentioned Dedicated vs hosted cost.
sam_eng: I can run a quick sim — two configs: current hosted + quantized model on Dedicated with burst. Need recent token distribution and avg seq length.
leila_cs: Sam — can you use the last 30 days window and assume peak qps ~18? If you can drop a sample command that procurement would understand that’d help.
sam_eng: Quick curl to pull sample usage metrics: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://console.redwood.example/api/usage?account=pinegrove&window=30d"``` I'll run this and share numbers by EOD tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
marco_ae: I’ll draft a short email to Jordan Lee now proposing a 30m demo that focuses on per-query cost, latency SLOs, and auditability. Will include ROI bullets and our Dedicated burst option.
procurement_ops_bot: Reminder: renewal window opens in 24 days for Pinegrove Retail.
leila_cs: Plan: 1) Sam shares perf + cost sims by EOD tomorrow; 2) Marco sends procurement note today and proposes demo; 3) I schedule a 30m win-back/demo for next Tue. Capture feature asks: explainability and audit logs.
jordan_csm: Also confirm who on their side owns the trial metrics — ask for access or weekly exports. They flagged wanting token-level cost visibility.
marco_ae: Drafted email, pinging Jordan Lee and cc'ing procurement. Will attach short ROI slide and a one-pager on Dedicated burst + quant profiles.
leila_cs: Nice. If Sam’s sim shows <15% cost increase with 30% latency gain we push that as the main tradeoff. Add a short example snippet for model explainability in the demo.
sam_eng: Got it. Will include a tiny demo script for explainability (saliency example) and a cost delta table.
leila_cs: No blockers from me. Any objections or other asks? :thinking_face:
jordan_csm: No objections. One more ask — please log this as a high-priority renewal risk in Gainsight and tag with `competitive_trial`.
leila_cs: Done. Added tag and brief note.
marco_ae: Sending email now. Will update thread once Jordan Lee replies. :rocket:
